LatiqIdentityFacet.description: The identity Latiq attributed this run to. `verified` distinguishes a principal proven by a validated token from a relaxed-mode claim; `agentIdVerified` is always false because the agent id is a claimed leaf that rides an HTTP header and never carries authority.

verified.description: Whether `subject`/`issuer` came from a validated token.

subject.description: The verified principal, and null whenever `verified` is false — a relaxed-mode caller has no principal, and an empty string would render as a blank owner rather than as its absence. `agentId` carries the claimed leaf in that case.

issuer.description: The token issuer, absent in relaxed mode.

agentId.description: The claimed agent leaf from the `latiq-agent-id` header.

agentIdVerified.description: Always false: the agent id is claimed, never verified.
